game.title: Dead Island 2
game.blurb: First-person zombie action RPG set in Los Angeles, with online co-op, from Dambuster Studios, released 2023-04-21. RAWG average playtime: 11 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The story quests across Hell-A and their hidden milestones. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Side Quests and Lost & Found
chapters.summary: Non-story quests and the Lost & Found weapon and missing person quests.

chapters.title: Challenges and the Zompedia
chapters.summary: Zombie, Weapon, Combat, Survivor, Exploration and Blueprint Challenges, and every zombie type.

chapters.title: Loot, Collectibles and Levels
chapters.summary: Legendary weapons, Zombie Lockboxes, Journals, Skill Cards, upgrading weapons and reaching level 30.

chapters.title: Combat Feats
chapters.summary: Fury Attacks, elemental damage, maiming, finishers, defensive moves and other ways to slay.

chapters.title: Co-op
chapters.summary: Quests and revives with other Slayers online.

chapters.title: New Game+
chapters.summary: Finishing every story quest again in NG+.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "Dead Island 2" or "Dead Island II". deadisland.fandom.com answers the API with about 271 linked articles, mostly weapons and characters, plus places such as "Halperin Hotel", "Venice Beach", "Ocean Park" and "Hollywood Boulevard" and the add-on pages "Haus (DLC)" and "SoLA (DLC)"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Project Phoenix" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 934700. 27 of 59 Steam achievements are hidden; all sit in the main story chapter. The first 15 fall steadily in unlock rate and read like story quests; the hidden ones further down the list, such as "Lawn and Order" (2%), "Drop The Beat", "No Encores", "Three's a Crowd", "Festival Clean Up Simulator" and "Shoulda Stayed Dead" (2%), have low rates and may belong to the Haus or SoLA add-ons (which RAWG lists as separate entries), but the data does not say. The co-op chapter needs online play.
